The 13th AHV (Alters- und Hinterlassenenversicherung) pension, also known as the 13th monthly pension, will be paid out for the first time in **December 2024** (assuming the current year is 2023 and the payment schedule remains consistent). 

Regarding the **amount comparison**, the 13th AHV pension is typically calculated as one-twelfth (approximately 8.33%) of the total annual pension. Therefore, it is **smaller** than the regular monthly pensions but represents an additional benefit for retirees. The exact amount depends on an individual's average indexed monthly income during their contribution period.
